function.description: Calculate the final velocity of an object in motion given its initial velocity, acceleration and time. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.reasoning: The user asks in Chinese: "最新的電影上映有哪些？" meaning "What are the latest movie releases?" They want a list of recent movies. We need to provide a list. We can give a short answer. No tool needed.
